QuestInfo.name: Final Choice
QuestInfo.0: Korin didn't turn into an adult even after eating the #t4033863#. She seems to be determined about something. Go speak to her.
QuestInfo.1: Korin says she will turn into an adult even if releasing Ludibrium's time is the only way. Korin says she needs #r#t4033864##k to release the seal on time.
QuestInfo.2: You were able to get #r#t4033864##k which will release the time but you are not sure if it would be okay to give this to Korin.

0.0: If I still can't become an adult even after eating #t4033863#, then there's only one option left. I have to release the time locked up in the Ludibrium Clocktower. With time flowing again, I can finally grow up!
0.1: Yes, some may prefer time to remain stalled in Ludibrium, but I can't let that get in the way of my dreams. Please help me. I can't give up trying to become an adult for the sake of my family.

yes.0: I need the #r#t4033864##k to unseal Ludibrium's time. Papulatus on the bottom floor of the Clocktower should have it. Please, bring me the key.

no.0: I must protect my family. Please help me.

default.0: I need #r#t4033864##k from the Papulatus to unseal time in Ludibrium.
